# Essential Korean Vocabulary

> A free website for learning Korean vocabulary in daily sets of 10 words. 50 days, 500 words. Each word has Hangul, romanization, an English meaning and a recorded pronunciation. Learners practice with flashcards, multiple choice (both directions), typing and listening, and missed words come back through spaced review (Leitner boxes: 1, 3, 7 and 16 days). No account is needed; progress stays in the browser.
